verdict.rationale: Limitless's own developer docs describe an official Limitless MCP server that Claude and other MCP-compatible tools can connect to for searching and asking about Lifelogs, with ChatGPT supported via Connectors on Pro and Workspace accounts. This is a first-party MCP server, though only briefly documented. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP tools exposed and their setup/auth flow, independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, and ChatGPT support on non-Pro/Workspace plans.
